domain: CMA (seller valuation) and BPO (buyer price opinion) products
summary: Adversarial re-verification largely upholds the original audit — this domain is genuinely built, not doc-only — but the auditor cited a DEAD delivery path as its headline evidence and missed two live intake callers. Corrections: (1) `lib/cma-deliver.ts:finalizeAndDeliverCma` (Gmail-draft rail) is reachable only by manually POSTing `/api/cma/[slug]/finalize-deliver`; grep across `app/`, `components/`, `lib/` finds ZERO UI or cron callers. The actual production send rail is `lib/cma/send.ts:sendCmaToLead`, wired into five real surfaces. The capability is still "have", but the auditor's evidence pointed at orphaned code — exactly the failure mode this pass exists to catch. (2) CMA intake has FOUR entry points, not three: the auditor missed `app/lp/fsbo/actions.ts:328` and `app/lp/expired-listing/actions.ts:287`. (3) BPO has no PDF renderer at all (CMA has `lib/cma-pdf.ts`) — an unremarked parity gap. Everything else verified line-by-line: the cron is registered, the accuracy contract genuinely kills builds, `deriveOfferStrategy` is real 166-line logic, and the proactive saved-home/favorite BPO trigger is confirmed absent.

items.requirement: Proactive BPO offer triggered by saved-search/favorite behavior ('I saw you were looking at this home, want our opinion on price?')
items.evidence: Searched harder and confirm absent. Saved-home infrastructure DOES exist (app/account/saved-homes/page.tsx, lib/pulse-saves.ts, components/site/ListingCard.tsx favorite affordance) — so the signal source is present and unconsumed. But: grep for 'bpo' (case-insensitive) across lib/crm/, lib/marketing-brain/, app/api/cron/ returns exactly ONE file, app/api/cron/marketing-snapshot-meta-page/route.ts, whose hits are 'fbPosts'/'fbPostRows' false positives — not a single cron or CRM module references BPO. app/api/cron/saved-search-alerts (vercel.json:128) sends listing alerts only. app/api/cron/visitor-hot-lead-escalation creates a crm_tasks call task (createNativeTask, line 34/305) and emails MATT_ALERT_EMAIL (:237-242) — broker-facing only, no lead-facing message, no BPO. No 'content:bpo' action_type anywhere.
items.gap: [VERIFIED] Entire feature absent. The favorite/saved-home signal is captured and stored but has no consumer that offers a price opinion.
items.why_it_matters: Explicitly requested product tie-in. The plumbing (saved homes, engagement scoring, BPO builder, tracked send rail) all exists in isolation — only the connecting trigger is missing, which makes the absence more glaring, not less.

shared_primitives_needed: Delete or wire lib/cma-deliver.ts. Two divergent CMA delivery implementations exist; only lib/cma/send.ts is reachable. The dead one uniquely holds PDF-attachment and FUB-BCC behavior — either port those into send.ts or remove the module, but do not leave both.
A BPO PDF renderer at parity with lib/cma-pdf.ts + /api/cma/[slug]/pdf. BPO currently has no document artifact, only a link.

Extend the judge -> adversarial audit -> self-repair chain (lib/cma/judge.ts, lib/cma/audit.ts) to lib/bpo/build.ts, or explicitly document that BPO is deterministic-only and label it as such in the client-facing document.
A 'content:bpo' action_type + bpo-build-worker cron mirroring createCmaRequest + cma-build-worker, so an inbound buyer signal can queue a build the same way seller intake does.
A consumer for the existing saved-home / pulse-saves signal (lib/pulse-saves.ts, app/account/saved-homes) — the tracking plumbing is built and unused for this purpose.
An alarm on ANTHROPIC_API_KEY absence: both lib/cma/judge.ts:124 and lib/cma/audit.ts:186 fail open, so a key outage silently degrades every CMA to needs_review with no operator signal.
open_questions_for_owner: lib/cma-deliver.ts (Gmail draft + PDF attachment + FUB BCC) has no caller. Was it superseded by lib/cma/send.ts intentionally, or did a UI trigger get dropped? The PDF attachment and the ryan.realty@followupboss.me BCC only exist in the dead path — do you want those behaviors back on the live send?

Should BPO run the same LLM comparability judge and adversarial audit as CMA? Today it is deterministic-only with a 69-line contract vs CMA's 203 — and BPO is the one recommending specific offer dollar amounts.
Should a BPO be deliverable as a PDF, or is the tracked link view sufficient for the buyer-side product?

For the proactive 'want our opinion on price' trigger: what counts as the signal — a saved home (lib/pulse-saves.ts already records these), N repeat views, or the existing engagement_score threshold? And should it auto-build the BPO or just queue a broker prompt?
Is RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET set in Vercel prod with the endpoint registered in Resend? The route fails closed with a 500, so if it is unset every webhook event is being silently rejected.
